title: My Son Forged Dissolution Of Our Lure Company, Left Me A Tackle Box. So I Voided The $590K Sale
description: After my son forged a dissolution to sell our handcrafted lure company for $590K, leaving me nothing but a $3,800 tackle box, I found our original partnership contract hidden inside a hollow wooden lure. I voided the sale, took back the business, and now he works for me in a vest that reads 'Hooked on Lies' with his fraud docket number on every package. #FamilyBetrayal #Comeuppance #Justice
thumb_text: HE FORGED THE SALE. NOW HE WEARS 'HOOKED ON LIES'
pinned_comment: If your son forged a dissolution and left you a $3,800 tackle box after selling your shared lure company for $590K, what would you have done? Share your story below.
